abbreviations.sign: suspension of final ν: short horizontal or hooked stroke above/after the preceding vowel
χ with superscript ς-shaped sign and circumflex

orthography: Upright minuscule with many uncial forms (Η, Κ, Δ, Ε, Γ, Τ, lunate sigma at word end; sigma forms normalised to σ/ς in the transcription). Frequent ligatures: q-shaped ει (εἰς, εἴρηται, ἔχει, κείσθω), στ (διαστήματα, διάστασις), ευ (ὁδεύονται, εὐρύθμως), εσ/εσθ (τεσσάρων, λέγεσθαι), ετ (μετά, τετράγωνον), θε, υν (looks like ω: ἀσύνθετα, δύναμιν, οὖν), ου as ȣ. ω usually in the barred (ϖ-like) form, sometimes open. ν is normally written in a μ-like form with descender and is distinguished from μ only by context; transcribed by sense. Final α (often looped, λ/δ-like at line end) and final αι are hardly distinguishable; read by grammar (ἀσύνθετα, ὁμαλότητα). β in the u-shaped form; ψ cross-shaped; ε also in a tall looped (6-like) form, used initially (ἐν, ἐκ, ἓν). Iota adscript written sporadically (τῶι 66r.12, 67r.6, 67r.7; λόγωι 66r.22; ὀγδόωι 67r.8), more often omitted (ταύτη 66r.4, τῆ 66v.2, τῶ 66v.10, 66v.22, 67r.4, 67r.6, 67r.8; ὀκταχόρδω, πρώτω, τάρτω, πέμπτω); no iota subscript. Accents and breathings regularly written; καὶ always with grave; grave often kept before punctuation (περιθεὶς., μετειληφὼς, πρός· has acute); some words without accent (μεν 66v.16, ἀναλογον 67r.11, ἡμιτονιου 67r.18, του 67r.5); oddities: διοδεὺον (66v.6), double accent in αὐτῶν (66r.22), ἄν with acute (66r.10), no coronis in ταυτὸν and κακεὶθεν. Elision marked with an apostrophe-like blob (δι' ἑνὸς, οὐδ' ἀσύνθετα, δι' ὀκτὼ, δι' ἕξ, δι' ἐννέα, εἴτ' οὖν, ἀπ' αὐτῆς, καθ' ὁμαλότητα, δ' ἀλλή-). Word spacing irregular (περι θεὶς, ἧτ τον, ἀνισο χρόνως). Punctuation: a dot whose height varies gradually from baseline to the top of the x-height (most at mid-height), and a comma-shaped low sign; the · / . distinction in this transcription is therefore approximate. Red ink only for initials in ekthesis (66r.12 Α, 67r.12 Ο, 67v.15 Τ); the red initial marks the first full line of a new paragraph even when the paragraph begins inside the preceding line (67v.14-15). Convention used here: a hyphen at line end marks a word continued on the next line (not written in the manuscript). No corrections, interlinear additions, marginal notes or diagrams on 66r-67v; 22 lines on each page.

doubts.issue: First word: περι + θ in open form joined to the ει-ligature + σ.
q-shaped ligature after μετ- read as ει; the same shape serves for α elsewhere.
Final letter of ἀσύνθετα: α with raised right stroke indistinguishable from αι.
Same α/αι ambiguity in ἀσύνθετα·
Line-final ρ of ἐπιτέρ- has a long looped tail ending in a horizontal stroke; next line begins with cross-shaped ψ.
doubts.options: ἐπιτέρ|ψη (preferred); the loop could hide a further letter

doubts.issue: συμφθάρ|σεως: letters fairly clear (σ υ μ φ θ ά ρ | σ ε ω ς), but the word is unusual; θ is a tall closed oval.
doubts.options: συμφθάρσεως (as read); θ/ο confusion would give συμφοράσεως (less likely)

doubts.issue: Tiny dot at baseline between ο and σ of μέλος.
Line-final ȣ ligature (οὐ) with hooked top; whether a breathing is incorporated is unclear; division οὐ|κ ἄμεσα.
αὐτῶν has a breathing and a grave over αυ in addition to the circumflex on ω; λόγωι could be λόγοι if the barred sign were οι.
Accent over ευ-ligature in διοδεὺον is a straight stroke descending to the right (grave), not a circumflex; εἴτ' οὖν: the dot after τ read as apostrophe.
κακεὶθεν: analysed as κ-α-κ + ει-ligature + θ (open) + ε + ν; the accent stroke over ει is grave-like; no coronis.
doubts.options: κακεὶθεν (= κἀκεῖθεν, preferred); καὶ εἶθεν; καὶ ἔνθεν

doubts.issue: Comma-shaped sign at baseline between τό and τε.
Dot after δὲ at mid-height; μεν without visible accent.
Line-final 7-shaped sign with grave after τὸ.
βά|ρει: acute over α of βα-, no accent on ρει (ει-ligature).
Line-final του (τ + ȣ) without visible accent.
συνανι|όντων: first nasal in the μ-like form.
Accent of δίεσις placed between ι and ε.
Sign after -ος at line start is comma-shaped; dot after ἔνατος at mid-height.
Two small dots below λόγον/ἡμιόλιον and a т-shaped sign above ν of ὑπεροχὴν in the interline; function unclear.
doubts.options: comma + reference sign; or later marks

doubts.issue: Article after πρὸς written τ-ο-ι-σ with grave.
doubts.options: τοὶς (as written, for τοὺς); τοὺς with υ in an unusual form

doubts.issue: High point vs middle point: dot height varies gradually; assignments · / . are judgments from enlargements, and low comma-shaped dots are given as ',' only where the tail is clear.
